name: Affect Normal Fog
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a tiny candle and a small horn that is not consumed)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area 50 cubic ft./level
Duration 10 minutes/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell allows a caster to manipulate a normal fogbank. The fog can be made into a thick, obscuring mass of watery vapors that limit normal sight to 5 feet. The spell can alternately be used to thin away an existing fogbank to allow for easier sight and clear navigation. Only normal, naturally occurring fog can be affected; any magically created fog is not subject to this spell.
